versions.changelog:
Version 1.1.0 of client-project-tracker introduces privacy controls and tightens trigger rules.

- Added a new Privacy and Data Handling section: clarifies what is saved, when/where, and user rights to delete or review data.
- Now shows a first-use notice describing what will be stored before saving to client-data.json.
- Prevents storing unneeded sensitive information (like bank details or IDs); will warn and exclude if user tries to log them.
- Skill only activates when user clearly wants to add, update, or review tracked client/project data (no longer triggers on generic client or freelance advice).
- Explicit deletion instructions and confirmation before removing any data.
- Evaluation and sample files removed for a leaner footprint.
v1.0.1 - Documentation cleanup. Frontmatter version quoted for CLI compatibility, added CHANGELOG.md. No behavior changes.

Initial release of client-project-tracker

- Track clients, projects, deliverables, deadlines, invoices, and communications for freelancers and consultants.
- Organizes all data in a JSON file with clear schema for persistence and retrieval.
- Provides easy conversational commands for adding clients, managing project phases, tracking invoices, and logging communication.
- Includes proactive nudges for overdue deliverables, unpaid invoices, and pending client follow-ups.
- Presents concise summaries and dashboards on request to keep workload and revenues clear.
